title: Just ok
text: Just ok. This parchment is just okay. It’s very thin and even when my item is baking in a 350° oven, it still gets really brown. If you’re broiling on this, the paper will flake and turn to embers. It is smaller than a classic sized sheet pan but I like to have a few different sizes. This is more for a toaster oven. I wouldn’t re order this. And plan to search for a different brand next time.
